summary.text: Paul Rose is a Republican state senator representing Tennessee Senate District 32 (Lauderdale, Shelby and Tipton Counties), a member of the 111th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Joint Education, Health and General Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rose holds a B.A. from the University of Tennessee at Martin and is president of Rose Construction.
He is married to Nancy and has three children and six grandchildren.
In the Senate he is vice-chair of the Government Operations Committee and second vice-chair of the Judiciary Committee.

His page lists service as chairman of the Dyersburg State Foundation Board in 2017-2018, president of the Tennessee Baptist Children's Home Board of Trustees in 2012 and chairman of the Covington-Tipton County Chamber of Commerce board in 1991-1992.
